E0735

`{path}` is not a known tag source or destination.

What

`{path}` is not a known tag source or destination.

Why

`deny` entries name effects or registered sinks; `from` entries name effects or function paths.

Fix

Correct the path using the suggested effect, sink, or declared function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0735: tests/ui/tag_unknown_destination.stderr.

Error [E0735]: `Nte` is not a known tag destination
  --> tests/ui/tag_unknown_destination.jet:1:19
    |
  1 | tag Risk { deny: [Nte] }
    |                   ^^^
 Why: a `deny` entry names an effect or a registered sink
 Fix: did you mean `Net`?
